Weapon status green means the weapon is completely unloaded.

Weapon status amber means that the magazine is loaded normally and ammo is ready to be chambered. Walking around the base like this is a BIG NO NO.

Weapon status red means a round is chambered.

It depends on the situation.

Generally speaking if you are inside the base, you are always green.

Exceptions to this are common sense, for instance, if you are manning a tower looking out of the base, you are still in the base, but you are in a dangerous situation, so you would go red when in a tower.

The second best place to put a magazine is Velcroed to the butstock. But that's not nearly as quick as being inserted butt first. We are talking about a good 15 seconds to fire.

The third best place to put a magazine is in an ammo pouch on your body, but you have the same problem as the second, and maybe you are off duty and don't have all your gear with you. A weapon is worthless if you don't have the magazine.
